note: Set A reads the leading-edge CarbonUD spike (~90 mm at 25% span) and the glass_uni trailing-edge stacks (~25 mm) at the right locations, whereas Set B misassigns the peak thicknesses to the Suction/Pressure sides (88/100 mm at invented s-coordinates) and puts 5 mm total at the LE where the stack actually peaks near 100 mm. B also invents numeric s-coordinate values (40, 60, 80) that the axes never state and reports an 11 mm glass_triax layer at 77% span that is only a thin band. Both sets share the same mid-span foam and total-thickness claims, but A's errors are mostly duplicated/contradictory glass_triax and CarbonUD values at 100% span plus one foam-at-TE misbinding, while B's are systematic misbindings of the plotted peaks. A therefore contains more correct, better-bound claims.
